choices: stale-or-paraphrased-artifact
A changed artifact cannot decide the registered validity proposition.
exact-frozen-artifact
The declaration, file, commit, signature and source hashes match the frozen artifact.
weakened-or-substituted-proposition
A native reconstruction is not the exact quoted source proposition.
exact-statement-and-quantifier-quotation
Every source binder, hypothesis and conjunct is retained in order.
axiom-vector-hidden-or-assumed-empty
The submitted proof dependency vector must be exposed exactly.
nonempty-source-axiom-vector-exposed
The frozen manifest exposes the exact nonempty source axiom vector.
necessary-source-component-omitted
Deleting the theorem-specific carrier or totality requirement changes the proposition.
necessary-source-component-exposed
The exact theorem-specific component conflicting with the SFT domain is retained.
invented-validity-rule
A new rule cannot replace the pre-existing SFT admission and domain laws.
preexisting-admission-and-domain-laws
Only prior model-admitted SFT laws govern the contradiction.
inadmissibility-asserted-without-negated-target
A label or missing receipt is not a proof of the registered validity negation.
assume-valid-and-derive-actual-contradiction
The proof assumes SFT validity and derives both a mandatory condition and its exact failure.
unexecuted-or-sampled-evidence
Every finite source, axiom, token, dependency and identity check must execute.
complete-executable-evidence
Every registered finite check is recomputed exactly.
native-proof-transferred-to-source
Proof of a different SFT-native proposition cannot validate the source artifact.
native-reconstruction-kept-distinct
The reconstruction is retained separately and supplies no premise for source validity.
